blocking_findings.detail: The loader inserts R35 with parent_release_id NULL; no release-status events or release-change ledger rows are inserted, while root state claims parent R31.
The all-release candidate count is only 141, IDs 142-282. Prior candidate families/revisions are absent; skipping numbers is not an append-only migration.

Only packet export code recomputes full hashes, for 40 candidates. No delivered code produces the claimed 141-candidate update; the report checks only 64-character length and absence of a literal substring.
A stripped redirect object containing only endpoints passes the shipped schema and validator after hash recomputation.
Fixture code references absent old candidate revisions, uses the main schema, retains PASS_ALREADY_COMMITTED, and implements far fewer mutations than the report claims.
Six strata are implemented through unrelated origins or risk states rather than their named evidence.
A global used set prevents an eligible candidate from satisfying multiple strata, producing false shortfalls and arbitrary substitutes.
The verifier checks hash length, report PASS cells, and fixture case count instead of recomputing release lineage, all candidate evidence, typed schemas, pilot eligibility, or fixture execution.
Both governed Latinobarómetro file paths lack ZIP UTF-8 flag bit 0x800 and decode as mojibake under Python zipfile.
R35 is recorded with builder_version p3a-phase3-loader-v30 and migration artifact section 52.
